speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have had your nose in the almanac. If it has given you an hour, I have not heard you say it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It gave me the day, and no hour. I am not writing one in the margin to please a bell.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then please mine. The half hour is past, near enough, and Shoreditch is not in this close. I am carrying the cloth. I am not putting it down to wave you off.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not put it down. I am going. I will be back when you cut the loaf, and not with a play in my mouth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See that you are. The grey is the right cloak. The road will be loud past the gate, and louder coming home if you have let a yard into your head.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The yard is this afternoon. The morning is paper. I can tell the two apart without a speech at the door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then tell them apart up the street, where I cannot hear you. Dinner will be here. I will not send it looking for you.
